serverInfo.name: KYA Brasil
serverInfo.title: KYA Brasil
serverInfo.description: KYA backed by a real company. A Brazilian company signs with its e-CNPJ (ICP-Brasil) that an AI agent key (EVM, Web Bot Auth or ERC-8004) acts for it within a mandate. Every day the issuer checks that the e-CNPJ is not revoked (ICP-Brasil CRL) and the company is still ATIVA at the Receita; risk (sanctions, debt) is the verifier's call. Credentials are Ed25519-signed, verifiable offline, revocable at once; every per-action verdict is signed. Verification free up to 50/day per IP, then x402.
